records.name: Bududa America Foundation
records.notes: Work is in Bududa, Uganda: a vocational academy, support for orphaned children, nutrition, and solar and erosion projects. The site describes no Philadelphia program or event. The IRS record lists a Philadelphia address (111 Rex Ave, 19118), which is not a program site on the page. The footer names the Bududa Canada and America Foundations; legal status is not published. Newest item: a 2025 annual report post with no month. Published email: info@bududa.org.

records.name: Caribbean Coalition for Maternal and Reproductive Health
records.notes: The stated aim is the Caribbean region and the events are online. The IRS record lists a Philadelphia address (26 W Upsal St, 19119), but no Philadelphia program is shown. Latest dated item: an online strategic planning discussion on January 27, 2026. Verdict out_of_area; the owner may choose differently for online groups that have a Philadelphia office. Published email: info@ccmrh.org.

records.name: Cliveden
records.notes: Cultural Fund lead. The website returned HTTP 403 on the one fetch, so nothing about programs, dates, hours, tickets or contacts was read. Held back for a later pass by someone who can reach the site. Address on the IRS record: 6401 Germantown Ave, 19144. Legal name: Cliveden of the National Trust Inc.

records.name: Collectively Free
records.notes: Animal rights and vegan advocacy with a national and international scope. The site shows no Philadelphia programs, events or address. The IRS record lists 267 E Slocum St, 19119. Newest dated item: a blog post noting an update in May 2022 (posts show day and month only). Verdict out_of_area; the owner may want to review because of the Philadelphia IRS address. Social: facebook.com/collectivelyfree, twitter.com/collective_free, youtube.com/user/collectivelyfree, instagram.com/collectivelyfree.

records.name: Community Enrichment Fitness Network
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that helps older adults eat well and stay active through health events, nutrition programs, and a senior community where people meet and keep moving.
records.what_you_do: Come to health and nutrition events, join the senior community to socialize and stay active, or volunteer at health events.

schedule.text: Health and nutrition events, including the 6th Annual Senior Harvest Ball on Friday, October 23, 2026.

cost.text: Ticket price for the Senior Harvest Ball is not listed

first_step.how: Visit cefn.org/programs and use the Join Us Today link, or call (215) 858-4957 to ask about the next senior program.
first_step.basis: The programs page has a Join Us link, and the group lists a public phone line and email for questions.

records.notes: The site gives a PO Box (PO Box 4122, 19144), so no meeting place is listed. Nutrition programs are named but not described. Volunteer, internship and partner pages are linked but were not read. Event prices are not stated. Legal name: Community Enrichment Fitness Network.

records.name: The Crossing
records.notes: Professional chamber choir led by Donald Nally; it performs and records new music. The only public way in is buying concert tickets (2026 to 2027 season, including concerts in Chestnut Hill and Center City Philadelphia). The site lists no auditions, classes, membership, volunteer or community program, so under the company rule it is not_a_group. The owner may reconsider if a community or education program exists. The batch website crossingchoir.com redirects to crossingchoir.org. Published email: info@crossingchoir.org. Legal name: Crossing Inc.

records.name: East European Jewish Heritage Project USA
records.notes: The website on the batch record (voluntas-international.org) belongs to a different organization called Voluntas, so it is not recorded as this group's site. One search found no Philadelphia activity. Search summaries (pages I did not open) describe a 1999 newsletter about a group of this name working on East European Jewish culture, aid, and restoration of sites, with a Minsk address, and a UK charity register entry giving an area of benefit of Eastern Europe. That UK register page returned HTTP 403 when fetched. IRS record address: 221 Pelham Rd, 19119. Verdict out_of_area with low confidence; the owner may review.

records.name: EMIR Healing Center
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that supports people and families affected by homicide and violence, with restorative circles, violence prevention work, and a list of healing resources.
records.what_you_do: Call or email to ask for support, or sign up as a volunteer through the Become a Volunteer page. Restorative circle practices are one of its listed services.

cost.text: Cost of services is not listed on the site

first_step.how: Call 215-848-4068 (the site says call any time) or sign up through emirphilly.org/become-a-volunteer.
first_step.basis: Support and volunteering are open to the public, with a listed phone line and an online volunteer page.

records.notes: Legal name: Emir-Every Murder Is Real. The EIN on the site (23-2990505) matches the IRS record. No dated events are listed. The newest text is a donate banner that says 2026, which is not counted as an event, so status is probably_active and no month is recorded. The footer shows a placeholder phone number, (406) 555-0120; the 215 number is the published one. Support_group is true because the site describes support circles for people affected by homicide. Donations go through a third-party payment page.

records.name: Envision Success
records.summary: Helps young adults who are leaving foster care build everyday independent living skills, with life skills training and a safe place to live.
records.what_you_do: Apply to a program, learn life skills with the staff, or apply to volunteer or become a member.

first_step.how: Fill in the Program Entry form linked from envisionsuccess.org to ask about joining a program.
first_step.basis: Joining needs a form, and the site does not say who qualifies, so the way in is not clear.

records.notes: The home page links a program entry form, a volunteer application and a membership application (third-party form links, not recorded here). No address, phone or email is published; the contact page has form fields only. No dated events or news were found. The events page is linked but was not fetched. The site says it serves the Greater Philadelphia area. Eligibility for the program is not stated. Legal name: Envision Success Inc.

records.name: Extended Play
records.summary: A nonprofit that works with filmmakers who make films for social change, handling grant money for film projects and helping arrange screenings and outreach in the Philadelphia area.
records.what_you_do: Email the group about a film project you are making. It can handle project funds through fiscal sponsorship and help set up screenings and distribution.

cost.text: Fiscal sponsorship takes a fee of 5% to 10% of the grant, depending on its size

first_step.how: Email extendedplayinc@gmail.com with a short description of your socially conscious film and what you need: funding, screenings, or distribution.
first_step.basis: The only way in is an email, and the site does not say how projects are chosen.

records.notes: A narrow service for filmmakers, not a community group with meetings or classes, so the owner may decide whether it belongs in the directory. Board names are on the site and were not recorded. The social links are placeholders, so none are recorded. The site says the focus has been on artists who use film for social change since 2026 (no month). No phone or street address is published.

records.name: Fayton Foundation
records.summary: A Northwest Philadelphia group that runs a weekly food program for neighbors and seniors, a Sunday prayer gathering, a spring neighborhood cleanup, and school coaching and scholarships.
records.what_you_do: Get a meal or food box on Tuesdays, join the Sunday prayer cafe, or come out for the spring cleanup of green spaces.

schedule.text: Food program on Tuesdays, 11 am to 1 pm. Prayer Cafe on Sundays at 9:30 am. A spring cleanup (no date given).

locations.label: Prayer Cafe at Holsey Temple Church

first_step.how: Come to the Tuesday food program at 5305-15 Germantown Ave between 11 am and 1 pm.
first_step.basis: The programs are listed as open to the public, and the site mentions no registration.

records.notes: The office address on the site is 5720 Wissahickon Ave, 19144; no phone is published. The email shown is support@faytonfoundation.org, but its link goes to faytonfoundation@gmail.com. Status is active because the site lists items for 2026 (New for 2026 programs) without months, so no month is recorded. The site does not say whether it is a private foundation. It runs public programs and lists an EIN, so it is kept in; the owner may review. Holsey Temple Church hosts the Prayer Cafe; the church was not checked as a separate group.

records.name: F.I.R.E. (Fire Free Inspiration Reaching Everyone)
records.notes: The www site returned only its name and tagline, with no programs, dates or contacts. The bare domain freeinspiration.org returned HTTP 403 and is listed under blocked. One search found nothing matching in Philadelphia. IRS record address: 135 E Pomona St, 19144. Held back until someone can read the site or find a public source.

records.name: Fresh Fire Inc Ministries
records.notes: The site gives its Sunday services and office at 8116 Old York Road, Elkins Park, PA 19027, which is in Montgomery County, outside Philadelphia. The same address is also given with a Philadelphia 19140 ZIP, which conflicts with 19027. Mailing address: P.O. Box 12336, Philadelphia, PA 19119. The IRS record lists 8030 Germantown Ave, 19118. The site has no dated events; its footer year (2017) is not counted, and its COVID-era notice is undated. Verdict out_of_area; the owner may review if it serves Philadelphia members. Published contacts: FreshFirePA@gmail.com, 800-596-7864, 267-930-4562.

records.name: GE2P2 Global Foundation
records.notes: A global research and bioethics foundation, founded in 2016 as a spin-off from an NYU medical ethics division. Its IRS record lists a Philadelphia office (605 West Upsal Street, 19119). Its work and centers are global, and the site lists no Philadelphia programs or events. The public way in is newsletters (a weekly digest and a monthly review); fellows and associates are elected by the board. Dated items on the site are from 2021 and 2022. Verdict out_of_area. Email published for advisory requests: david.r.curry@ge2p2global.org.

records.name: Greater Philadelphia Diversity Collaborative
records.summary: A group of educators and school leaders serving preschool through 8th grade. They meet to plan diversity and inclusion work, hold summits, and share ideas with schools that have small budgets or no diversity staff.
records.what_you_do: Educators can attend member meetings and the yearly summits, or ask about joining through the Join Us page.

schedule.text: Member meetings on a regular basis (dates not shown on the site). Educator summits are listed under Upcoming Events.

first_step.how: Email Info@GreaterPhiladelphiaDiversityCollaborative.org to ask how to join and when the next member meeting is.
first_step.basis: Membership is offered through a Join Us page, but the site does not say what joining involves or whether events are open to non-members.

records.notes: The site lists a PreSchool to 2nd Grade Educators Diversity Summit on Saturday, April 18, 2026 under Upcoming Events. That date has passed, so the list may be out of date. Other sidebar dates have no year and may be post dates. The top menu says the Resources page was taken down in May 2026, but a Resources link still appears in the main menu. No address or phone is published. Legal name: Greater Philadelphia Diversity Collaborative Assn.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used. Fetches: 19. Batch of 15 groups: 8 publish (Cliveden and F.I.R.E. are unknown and held back), 1 not_a_group, 6 out_of_area. Judgment calls the owner may want to review: Bududa (work in Uganda), Caribbean Coalition (Caribbean scope, online events), Collectively Free (national animal rights, Philadelphia IRS address), East European Jewish Heritage Project (work in Eastern Europe; the listed website belongs to another organization), Fresh Fire (worship in Elkins Park, Montgomery County), GE2P2 (global research foundation). The Crossing is not_a_group because its only public way in is concert tickets. Extended Play is a narrow filmmaker service with low confidence. Summaries were written fresh from the pages read. No leads_only items: the only other named places (Holsey Temple Church, Fabric Workshop and Museum, Presbyterian Church of Chestnut Hill) are venues with no URL seen.
